title: Evacuation ordered
description: Russian savages hit another train, the third train in a day. Russian anti-aircraft missiles attacked a suburban diesel train in the Sumy region, the State Emergency Service reported. A locomotive and a passenger car caught fire. 19 passengers were evacuated. 10 people were injured. During the rescue operation, the occupiers struck again. Fortunately, none of the firefighters were injured. All sources of burning are liquidated.
description_en: Russian savages hit another train, the third train in a day. Russian anti-aircraft missiles attacked a suburban diesel train in the Sumy region, the State Emergency Service reported. A locomotive and a passenger car caught fire. 19 passengers were evacuated. 10 people were injured. During the rescue operation, the occupiers struck again. Fortunately, none of the firefighters were injured. All sources of burning are liquidated.
description_uk: Российские дикари ударили по еще одному, уже третьему поезду за сутки Российские БпЛА атаковали пригородный дизель-поезд на Сумщине, сообщили в ГСЧС. Загорелись локомотив и пассажирский вагон. 19 пассажиров эвакуировали. Пострадали 10 человек. Во время спасательной операции оккупанты нанесли повторный удар. К счастью, никто из пожарных не пострадал. Все очаги горения ликвидированы.

title: Kyiv: 142 drones intercepted
description: 'As much harm as possible' — 5 killed, 63 injured as Russia resumes mass attacks across Ukraine As of 8:30 a.m., with the attack still ongoing, air defenses had downed or suppressed two ballistic missiles, 31 cruise missiles, and 142 drones. Strikes were recorded at 29 locations, while debris from intercepted drones and missiles fell at nine additional sites, the Air Force said.

title: Drone attack
description: Today, Russia attacked the media and journalists. An attack drone attacked the building of the "We - Ukraine" TV channel of the "Edyny Novyni" telethon. Just in the middle of the day. Just when the journalists were on the air. The building is partially destroyed. All necessary services are available on site. Employees of the State Emergency Service have already extinguished the fire. As of now, five victims are known. Unfortunately, the number may still increase...

description_uk: Сьогодні Росія завдала удару по медіа, по журналістах. Ударний дрон атакував будівлю телеканала «Ми – Україна» телемарафону «Єдині новини». Просто посеред дня. Саме тоді, коли журналісти були в ефірі. Будівля частково зруйнована. На місці працюють усі необхідні служби. Працівники ДСНС уже загасили пожежу. Станом на зараз відомо про пʼятьох постраждалих. На жаль, кількість ще може збільшитися....
